description: Hand-made foobos guides in Boston or Denver: themed lists like “Rare Shows”, “Cool New Shows”, “Top Shows This Weekend”, “On The Green Line” or “Altitude Adjustment”, each with a curator and a short intro. Use when someone wants ideas, a theme, or “what's special”. Then call get_guide with an id. Paginated: default 20, max 50, always includes total.

city.description: boston (default: Boston, Cambridge, Somerville and the rest of Greater Boston, Massachusetts) or denver (Denver, Boulder and the Colorado Front Range). Set denver for anything in Colorado.

limit.description: Page size. Default 20, max 50. Do not request the full list — tonight is ~174 shows / ~36k tokens.

offset.description: Rows to skip. Use with the returned total to page.

via.description: Inbound UTM source written onto every Foobos deep link. Default muse.

name: list_guides
title: Guides
